Evaluate a trigonometric Hermite series on a ciphertext

Source: R/functional-bootstrapping.R
eval_hermite_trig_series.Rd

The series evaluation inside functional bootstrapping. It approximates exp(i * pi / 2 * x) by the Chebyshev series coefficients_cheb on [a, b], squares it twice to get exp(2 * pi * i * x), evaluates the polynomial with coefficients coefficients_herm in that exponential, and returns twice the real part: 2 * Re(sum_j h_j exp(2 * pi * i * j * x)) (CKKS only).

Usage

eval_hermite_trig_series(
  ct,
  coefficients_cheb,
  a,
  b,
  coefficients_herm,
  precomp = 0L
)

Arguments

ct

A Ciphertext.

coefficients_cheb

Numeric or complex vector; Chebyshev coefficients of exp(i * pi / 2 * x) on [a, b].

a, b

Numeric; the interval of the Chebyshev approximation.

coefficients_herm

The coefficients of the Hermite series in powers of the exponential, divided by 2: an integer vector, or a double or complex vector.

precomp

Integer. 0L (default) or 1L: compute the exponential and keep it in the first or the second place. 2L: reuse the first one kept. Any other value: reuse the second.

Value

A Ciphertext.

Details

The exponential is kept in the bootstrapping precomputation of the context for the slot count of ct, in one of two places, so the context must have been set up for bootstrapping (eval_fbt_setup(), eval_bootstrap_setup() or eval_fe_func_bootstrap_setup()) and must hold the conjugation key (eval_bootstrap_key_gen()).
